subject: Hiring Committee: Decision on Product Manager (REQ-1954) — Closeout & No-Hire
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Hiring committee debrief — Jordan Cole (REQ-1954)

Team,

Thanks for carving out time today for the panel. Attached are the consolidated scorecard and the raw interviewer notes (Jordan_Cole_scorecard.pdf, interview_notes_REQ-1954.docx). Below is a short synthesis and a recommended committee decision.

Summary (consensus across interviewers):
- Strengths: clear communication, PM process familiarity, structured problem solving.
- Concerns: inconsistent product sense on trade-offs (mobile prioritization case), limited depth on metrics-driven experiments, and varying behavioral scores on stakeholder influence.
- Compensation: candidate is requesting $210k OTE and strong equity given competing offer; our posted band for REQ-1954 is $160k–$180k OTE.
- Availability: candidate indicated they have an offer deadline from another company in ~10 days.

Recommendation: NO-HIRE / closeout for this req. Rationale: skills fit is marginal relative to band; escalating comp beyond band is not possible without Headcount Committee approval and a reclassification of the role. Given the mix of feedback and the candidate's market leverage, the downside of forcing an over-band offer outweighs the potential upside.

Action items requested from committee:
1) Confirm decision to close the req (Greenhouse: mark as No Hire — Declined Offer/Other).
2) Approve sending a concise candidate closeout note (template attached: no_hire_template_email.txt). Monica will handle candidate comms if approved.
3) Record feedback and scorecard in Greenhouse and attach interviewer notes to the req (I can do this after confirmation).

If anyone strongly disagrees and thinks we should make a comp exception or re-open for a different band, please flag with a short note and suggested funding source (headcount reprioritization, title bump, or hiring freeze exception) — we can escalate to People Ops and Finance.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Talent Partner | Redwood Inference

Vivek —

Thanks for raising that. I flagged comp and headcount with People Ops during the interview loop. Quick updates:
- People Ops notes: an above-band offer would require Headcount Committee approval and a role reclassification; that process typically takes 7–10 business days and is not guaranteed.
- Finance: no unallocated headcount in this pod for Q2 without deprioritizing another req.

Given the timeline (candidate has a competing offer with an imminent deadline) and the mixed interview feedback, my recommendation remains to close. If we had a later timeline and stronger consensus, escalation could be justified.

Next steps if committee confirms close: I will mark the req as No Hire in Greenhouse, upload the scorecard and notes, and send the candidate the attached closeout email. I will copy the hiring manager on the outgoing candidate message.

Monica
